summary:
Found it: the check uses `"Error:"` (capital E) but errors are formatted as lowercase `"error: ..."`.Files changed: `calcx/report.py`
Root cause: the "ok" summary check compared error rows against the string prefix `"Error:"` (capitalized) while `evaluate_batch` actually formats errors as `"error: ..."` (lowercase), so the case mismatch meant no row was ever excluded from the "ok" count.
Test status: all 21 tests pass.
